descriptionChirho: Proper noun שִׁנְעָר (Shin'ar): the ancient region in southern Mesopotamia associated with Babel/Babylon (Gen 10:10; 11:2; 14:1; Isa 11:11; Dan 1:2; Zech 5:11). S142950 covers bare occurrences of the name, S142952 adds the conjunction and preposition 'and from Shinar'. All translations preserve the same toponym: eng Shinar, spa Sinar, hin शिनर, arb شِنْعَار, kor 시날, swa Shinari. The conjunction/preposition attachment is syntactic, not a distinct referent or meaning.
